description: Per-hobby correction layer applied after the base recipe. Supported scalar replacements: subject, environment, composition, camera, lighting, palette, visual_variant. Supported append arrays: emotion_add, recognition_anchors_add, must_include_add, avoid_add, override_prompt_additions. Use only after review/QA identifies a real need.

fashion.streetwear.subject: A young adult actively styling and wearing layered generic streetwear with distinctive silhouette, texture, sneakers, and accessories, with no visible brands or text
fashion.streetwear.environment: A clean contemporary urban setting with abstract architecture and color blocks only; no storefront names, posters, advertisements, signs, or readable environmental text
recognition_anchors_add: layered generic streetwear silhouette
streetwear sneakers and accessories without logos
urban fashion context without commercial signage
must_include_add: generic unbranded streetwear
clear fashion styling action or pose
background surfaces free of readable text
avoid_add: letters or words in the background
any real-world sneaker brand silhouette or trade dress
signature sole geometry associated with a known sneaker model
distinctive panel arrangement copied from a real sneaker
override_prompt_additions: Every garment, wall, storefront-like surface, poster-like surface, accessory, and background element must be completely free of readable words, letters, logos, brand marks, slogans, and pseudo-text. Where signage would normally appear, use blank material, abstract color blocks, or non-linguistic geometric patterns.

The footwear must be a generic, fictional, entirely unbranded sneaker design that is not recognisably derived from any real sneaker model or manufacturer: no signature sole geometry, no recognisable stripe layout, no swoosh-like mark, no three-stripe-like treatment, no distinctive panel arrangement, and no other trademark-like silhouette associated with a known shoe brand. Invent a plain, original shoe shape instead.

avoid_add: readable text of any kind on books
pseudo-text used decoratively on covers or spines
must_include_add: plain or abstract book covers and spines with no readable text
blank or non-linguistic page marks such as plain lines, dots, or abstract cover art only
visual identity carried by the physical books and the reading action, not by typography
override_prompt_additions: Every book cover, spine, and open page in this scene must be free of readable text: no title, no author name, no spine text, no invented words, no pseudo-publishing logo or imprint mark, and no poster/signage-style lettering anywhere. Book covers and spines should use plain colours, abstract patterns, simple non-linguistic ornament, or blank cloth/leather-like texture instead of typography. The scene must still clearly read as reading/books through physical book shapes, stacks, page texture, and an active reading gesture — not through any text on the books.

wellness.cold_plunge.subject: A person braced and alert in a cold plunge, submerged to the chest in visibly cold water with floating ice cubes, gripping the edge with a focused, invigorated expression
wellness.cold_plunge.environment: An outdoor cold-plunge or dedicated cold-therapy setting such as a winter garden, cold-spa deck, or ice-bath tub with frost/condensation on nearby surfaces, distinctly cold rather than steamy
recognition_anchors_add: visible ice cubes or floating ice in the water
condensation or frost on the tub rim or nearby surfaces
braced, alert, invigorated body language
crisp cold-weather or cold-spa atmosphere
must_include_add: clearly cold water with visible ice
an alert, braced posture rather than a relaxed soak
a cold-plunge or cold-therapy context that is unmistakably not a hot bath
avoid_add: relaxed soaking pose with closed eyes
sauna or hot-spring signage or architecture
override_prompt_additions: This must read unmistakably as a COLD plunge, not a warm bath or onsen: the water must look cold (clear, faintly blue-tinted, with visible floating ice cubes), any visible breath or vapor should read as cold-air breath rather than warm steam, and the person's expression and posture should be alert, braced, and invigorated rather than relaxed and melting into the water. Do not render rising steam, glowing warm light in the water, or a serene eyes-closed soaking pose — those read as a hot spring, which is the opposite of this hobby.

recognition_anchors_add: generic unbranded skate shoes with plain, original sole and upper construction
skateboard deck and trucks free of any logo or wordmark
must_include_add: plain, stylish, entirely unbranded skate shoes
a skateboard deck and hardware with no readable graphics, logos, or brand marks
avoid_add: readable brand text on footwear or deck
pseudo-brand mark on footwear or deck
any real-world sneaker brand silhouette or trade dress
signature sole geometry associated with a known sneaker model
recognisable skateboard deck graphic or brand logo
override_prompt_additions: The skate shoes must be a plain, generic, entirely unbranded design: invent an original sole tread, upper panel layout, and silhouette rather than reproducing any real skate-shoe brand's construction. No swoosh-like mark, no checkmark-like mark, no three-stripe-like treatment, no signature side-panel shape, no manufacturer badge, and no readable text anywhere on the shoes. The skateboard deck and trucks must likewise carry no readable logo, wordmark, or recognisable brand graphic. The shoes and board should still look stylish, well-designed, and true to real-world skate gear construction — not blank, sterile, or obviously censored.

avoid_add: readable text on scrolls, banners, or wall art
must_include_add: blank or abstract wall art if any wall art is present
override_prompt_additions: Any wall hanging, scroll, banner, or piece of wall art in this scene must be blank, abstract, or carry only non-linguistic ornament (simple ink-wash shapes, plain color fields, abstract brushwork patterns) - never readable Chinese calligraphy, readable scroll text, pseudo-characters that resemble writing, signage, or labels. The Tai Chi practice itself (posture, movement, setting) stays exactly as otherwise specified.

avoid_add: letters or numbers on the game box
letters or numbers on the table
letters or numbers anywhere in the background
override_prompt_additions: The finished artwork must contain absolutely no title, no caption, no typography, and no readable words or labels anywhere in the image. The board, cards, game pieces, game box, table surface, walls, and any posters or background details must use only abstract, non-linguistic symbols, icons, and patterns — never letters, numbers, or words of any kind, including as a caption beneath or within the scene.

learning.philosophy.subject: Two or three young adults actively discussing a philosophical idea, with one person explaining or debating a concept while pointing to a contemporary notebook, annotated book, logic/argument diagram, concept map, or simple philosophical thought-experiment sketch
learning.philosophy.environment: A modern library, university study space, bright reading room, contemporary cafe, or campus discussion setting that supports lively intellectual conversation
recognition_anchors_add: active intellectual discussion between two or three people
a modern book or notebook with a concept diagram or argument sketch
gestures showing debate, explanation, or reasoning
a contemporary study or discussion setting
must_include_add: at least one modern book or notebook
an active discussion or reasoning gesture
a visual cue of ideas or argument structure such as a concept diagram or annotated notes
avoid_add: ancient scroll as the primary focus
antique leather-bound tome as the primary focus
override_prompt_additions: This is a scene of contemporary intellectual discussion, not historical research, archaeology, or the occult. The book or notebook shown must read as a modern, ordinary object with handwritten notes or a simple diagram — never as an ancient tome, grimoire, or mystical artifact. Keep the emotional tone 'knowledge is exciting': curious, animated, and engaging, never gloomy, solemn, or mysterious.

business.fire_movement.subject: A small group actively planning financial independence using an entirely unlabeled physical planning system: colored blank cards, abstract bar and line shapes, arrows, circles, blank nodes, coins, and generic savings objects arranged on a board or table
must_include_add: an unlabeled physical financial-planning structure made of blank colored cards, abstract bars, arrows, circles, or blank nodes
coins or generic savings objects where appropriate to reinforce the financial-independence theme without any text
active collaborative planning gesture (pointing, arranging, discussing)
avoid_add: readable sticky-note label of any kind
any readable category name on a card or note
any readable diagram title or heading
any readable book spine or book title
sticky notes with any mark resembling a word or short phrase
override_prompt_additions: Represent the financial-planning activity entirely through unlabeled colored cards, abstract bars, arrows, circles, blank nodes, simple chart shapes, coins, and generic savings objects - never through any readable word, however short. If sticky notes appear anywhere in the scene, they must be completely blank or carry only a single abstract color/shape mark - never a mark that resembles a word, category name, or heading (not 'Side Hustles', not 'Investing', not 'Savings', not 'FIRE', not 'Income', not 'Expenses', not 'Retirement', not 'Goals', not 'Finance', and not any other readable label). Any book on a shelf or table must have a blank or abstract spine. The financial-independence/planning meaning must still come through clearly via the objects, gestures, and structure alone, not through any typography.

arts.comedy_writing.subject: A person actively brainstorming comedy material, pen or pencil in hand over a blank notebook or blank script pages, with an animated brainstorming gesture and an expressive comic-timing reaction on their face
arts.comedy_writing.environment: A believable writer's desk, rehearsal room, or small performance space appropriate to comedy writing, with no dictionary or thesaurus present
recognition_anchors_add: a blank notebook or blank script pages actively being written on
an animated brainstorming or comic-timing gesture
pen or pencil in active use
must_include_add: a notebook or script page with a blank cover and only non-linguistic short line marks on the page
an expressive, comedic brainstorming or rehearsal gesture
avoid_add: any reference book with a readable title
any book prop at all other than the writer's own blank notebook
override_prompt_additions: Do not include a thesaurus, dictionary, or any other reference book with a readable title anywhere in the scene - remove that prop entirely rather than trying to blank its cover. Represent comedy writing instead through a blank notebook or blank script pages (covers and pages carrying only non-linguistic short line marks, never readable words), a pen or pencil in active use, an animated brainstorming gesture, and an expressive comic-timing reaction. Any whiteboard or corkboard present must carry only blank or abstract shapes, never readable words. The scene must still clearly read as comedy writing specifically - through the writer's expressive, amused, quick-witted reaction and active scribbling energy - not as generic quiet studying.

arts.calligraphy.subject: A calligrapher mid-stroke with an ink-loaded brush, captured at the moment of a dynamic, sweeping, expressive brush movement across paper, with the camera favoring the brush tip, ink trail, hand action, and paper texture over any complete finished character
arts.calligraphy.environment: An intimate calligraphy studio nook - ink stone, brush rack, paper, and worktable - with no hanging wall scrolls, framed characters, or other wall-mounted writing anywhere in view
recognition_anchors_add: ink-loaded brush captured mid-stroke
visible ink trail and expressive gestural brushwork
ink stone and paper texture
must_include_add: an actively moving ink brush with visible ink trail
abstract, partial, gestural, or cropped brush strokes rather than one complete finished character or word
avoid_add: a complete readable Japanese kanji or kana character
a poem or quotation rendered as text
a seal or stamp containing readable text
any hanging wall scroll, framed calligraphy piece, or other wall-mounted writing in the background
override_prompt_additions: This hobby requires visible brush-and-ink mark-making - do not remove the brushwork itself. But the marks the brush makes must be abstract, partial, gestural, cropped, or overlapping: deliberately non-linguistic strokes that evoke the feeling and motion of calligraphy practice without ever completing a single recognizable real character, kanji, kana, or English word, and without forming a readable poem, quotation, or inscription. Favor a composition where the camera focuses tightly on the brush tip, the ink trail, the hand's motion, and the paper's texture, rather than a wide shot of a finished, readable piece of writing. Do not include any hanging wall scroll, framed calligraphy piece, or other wall-mounted writing in the background - remove those props entirely rather than trying to blank them. Abstract or partial brush strokes are the correct, desired outcome here, not a compromise.

arts.zine_making.environment: A creator's zine-making desk against a plain studio wall or blank corkboard background, surrounded by colored paper shapes, cut collage pieces, captionless photographs, tape, scissors, and glue - with no posters, flyers, wall typography, signs, or other readable wall decoration anywhere in view
recognition_anchors_add: plain studio wall or blank corkboard background
collage materials - colored paper shapes, cut pieces, captionless photographs, tape, scissors, glue
must_include_add: a plain or blank-corkboard background free of posters, flyers, or wall typography
background zine covers or pinned material, if any, that are blank or purely image-led with no readable titles
avoid_add: background zine cover containing a readable title
override_prompt_additions: The background must be a plain studio wall or a blank corkboard - not a wall covered in posters, flyers, gig-poster-style typography, signs, or banners. Any other zines, magazines, or pinned material visible in the background must be blank or purely image-led collage with no readable title, word, or caption anywhere on them. Represent the creative richness of the space through colored paper shapes, cut collage pieces, captionless photographs, tape, scissors, and glue instead of any readable print or typography. The main zine pages and covers the creator is actively working on must likewise stay blank, collage-based, abstract, or image-led, with no readable title - the scene must still clearly read as zine-making through the cutting, pasting, and layout activity itself.

recognition_anchors_add: generic unbranded dance sneakers with simple panel construction and plain side surfaces
generic streetwear free of manufacturer styling
must_include_add: plain, generic, entirely unbranded dance sneakers
generic streetwear with no manufacturer styling
avoid_add: three-stripe pattern on footwear or clothing
override_prompt_additions: The dancer's sneakers must be a plain, generic, entirely unbranded design: simple panel construction, plain side surfaces, no swoosh-like mark, no checkmark-like mark, no three-stripe pattern, no repeated parallel sportswear stripes, no signature side-panel shape, no manufacturer badge, no pseudo-logo, and no brand text. Keep clothing similarly generic streetwear with no manufacturer styling or recognisable brand color blocking. If showing full footwear detail is difficult to keep unbranded, reduce visual emphasis on the shoes (smaller in frame, partially cropped, or in motion blur) rather than rendering complex brand-like shoe detail. Any background graffiti must remain abstract color shapes and marks only - no letters, no tags, no readable symbols of any kind.

technology.ai.subject: A person actively exploring an abstract artificial-intelligence visualization made of glowing nodes, linked patterns, flowing data-like light, and model-like structures, without any readable interface
technology.ai.environment: A believable modern creative or research workspace where AI is represented through abstract light, nodes, diagrams, and spatial visualization rather than text-bearing screens
recognition_anchors_add: abstract neural-network-like nodes and connections
human actively interacting with an AI visualization
non-textual data or model visualization
must_include_add: clear human-to-AI interaction
abstract AI visualization
all interfaces free of readable text
override_prompt_additions: Do not render any readable interface copy. Any display or projection must contain only abstract shapes, nodes, light patterns, diagrams, and non-linguistic marks—no letters, words, numbers, code, slogans, logos, labels, captions, or pseudo-text.
